title: Control Systems Study Notes
description: Planned study notes on feedback, system models, stability and controller design, intended to accompany the Foundations of Control Systems series.

title: Introduction to Robotics Learning Path
description: A planned reading order through the basics of robot kinematics, sensing and motion planning, with the mathematics each step relies on.

title: Mathematical Methods for Engineering Notes
description: Planned notes on the linear algebra, calculus and differential equations that recur throughout computing, control and machine learning.

title: Numerical Methods and Simulation References
description: A planned list of public references on numerical methods and simulation. Each item will be added only after it has been checked and a real link is available.

title: Machine Learning Fundamentals Learning Path
description: A planned sequence of topics for learning the fundamentals of machine learning, intended to complement the Machine Learning Fundamentals series.

title: Computing Systems Study Notes
description: Planned notes on performance, parallelism and the structure of computing systems as they matter for scientific and robotic software.
